## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the trigger and what this changes for a user or coding agent. Link an issue if relevant.

## Validation

List checks actually run and relevant limitations. For performance claims, include correctness checks, versions, repeated measurements and a link to sanitized evidence.

## Compatibility and data

Describe any tool schema, configuration or persisted-state changes and migration steps. Confirm that examples, logs and fixtures are safe to publish and that reused material has appropriate attribution.
